06 / A FEW GOOD QUESTIONS

Before we begin.

How much does a website cost?+

Each project is quoted individually. The price depends on the pages, functionality, content, and work involved. Start with an inquiry so we can define the scope.

How long will my project take?+

The schedule depends on the project scope and when content and feedback are available. We’ll discuss a suitable timeline before work begins.

What should I prepare?+

A short description of your business and goals is enough to start. Existing branding, copy, photographs, and websites you like help shape the conversation.

What about hosting, domains, and updates?+

We’ll discuss the setup and any separate provider costs when defining the project. Ongoing updates can be scoped separately.

How do revisions and ownership work?+

The quote and project agreement will define review stages, included revisions, ownership, and handover arrangements before work starts.
